messages:
mira: Quick sync — following the postmortem, we need to split ownership for the token-count discrepancy remediation. I broke it into three workstreams: ingestion backfill, ledger reconciliation, invoice customer comms.

jon: Ack. Can you paste owners + rough deadlines?

mira: Owners: ingestion backfill -> sam (ETA 2026-05-10), ledger reconciliation -> alex (ETA 2026-04-30), invoice corrections + outreach -> jon (ETA 2026-05-17).

sam: Taking ingestion backfill. Plan: re-run the 2026-03 token batches with corrected parser, then compute delta per customer and stage a credits report. Will need 12h maintenance window to run heavy reprocess.

alex: For ledger reconciliation I'll create a dedupe/merge pass and a nightly job to prevent recurrence. Main cause looks like duplicate events from the ingest retry window. I'll add a metric and alert.

jon: I'll own communications & invoice adjustments. Drafting template for affected customers and credit memo process. Need final deltas from sam and ledger confirmation from alex before sending.

mira: Action items captured. Two quick asks: (1) sam — can you post the exact SQL you plan to use for delta calc? (2) alex — add the alert name + thresholds.

sam: SQL snippet: ```
-- per-customer token delta after reprocess
SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens_new - tokens_old) AS token_delta
FROM token_buckets_temp tb
JOIN token_buckets_archive ta USING (customer_id, window_id)
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING SUM(tokens_new - tokens_old) != 0;
```
Will run in dry-run mode first.

alex: Alert: `ingest_retry_dup_rate > 0.5%` for 15m triggers page. Create runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ingest-retry-dedupe.

mira: Nice. Sam — can you confirm estimated infra cost for reprocess? We need finance approval.

sam: Estimate ~0.8 GPU-days (~$2k). Jon, you'll want to include that in communications?

jon: I'll include cost note and new credit schedule. Also flagging a one-off invoice correction flow: issue credit memos, tag invoices with `adjusted_by=postmortem-2026-03`.

billing-bot: Scheduled job created: `postmortem_credit_memo_queue` (run_after: 2026-05-11).

mira: Timeline check — alex finishes reconciliation by 2026-04-30, sam finishes reprocess + delta report by 2026-05-10, jon issues credits between 2026-05-11 and 2026-05-17. I'll own closure and postmortem follow-up doc.

sam: Will post progress updates in this thread and attach S3 links to the delta CSVs.

alex: Will add alert and PR for dedupe job by EOD tomorrow.

jon: I'll draft the customer email and run by legal. ETA 2026-05-12 for the first draft.

mira: Great. Recurrence prevention note: add retrospective that looks at retry/backoff policy and the idempotency keys. Adding as a follow-up action for infra team (mira -> infra).

sam: One more: a small subset (~0.2% of customers) saw delayed usage appear in the ledger two days late. I'll include a filter in the delta report to capture delayed-window anomalies.

mira: Thanks. I'll consolidate actions into the postmortem doc and circulate. Please set a calendar reminder for the 2026-05-18 closure sync. :calendar:
